data.synopsis:
Students of Night Raven College are invited to a gathering of prospective mages being held at Noble Bell College, in the distant City of Flowers. Clothed in borrowed finery, the visiting delegates anticipate the glorious masquerade that will mark the climax of the cultural exchange. Meanwhile, the bell that is the college's namesake rings relentlessly.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.title: Haru ni Nattara Koguma no Yugo Monogatari (Movie)
data.title_english: When Spring Comes The Story of Yugo, A little Bear. (Movie)
data.title_japanese: 春になったら こぐまのユーゴ物語
data.synopsis:
In the spring of 2020, Yugo's Grandmother travels from the countryside to finally spend some quality time with Yugo.
The two see a "comedy show" in the park together and later that night, Yugo has a good time telling his family about his day out.
However, the next day Covid-19 restrictions are put in place in town and Yugo is stuck at home.
Then, he learns that his grandmother is not feeling well. At first, Yugo patiently waits at home for things to return to normal, but eventually he gets bored and silently slips out of the house…
